generation.capability: loader.get_steering_constraints(family, type_name) returns REQUIRED+FORBIDDEN constraints for LLM generation prompt injection

repair.capability: loader.get_failures_for_type(family, type_name) returns known failure patterns to detect regressions; loader.get_repair_for_failure(fp_id) returns the validated fix strategy

semantic_validation.capability: loader.get_validator_rules(family, type_name) returns applicable validator rules for post-generation code checks

rerun_planning.capability: loader.is_known_failure(name) prevents re-discovery of known failures; loader.get_failure_pattern(id) provides root cause and fix

sample_queries_verified.result_summary: 5 REQUIRED constraints including AddInput, AddOutput, MergeOptions, using Aspose.Pdf.Text
REQUIRED: PdfAConvertOptions; FORBIDDEN: PluginOptions, LowCodeLoadOptions, LowCodeSaveOptions

persistence_mechanism: File-based: registries are git-committed JSON files. HealingIntelligenceLoader reads them at import time. Survives across sessions, processes, and pipeline runs.
graceful_degradation: If registry files are missing, loader degrades to empty knowledge (warnings logged) — pipeline runs proceed without crashing.
test_coverage: tests/unit/test_healing_intelligence_activation.py — 8 test classes, 35+ test cases covering all load, query, and degradation paths
